error.tryRefreshOrReplace: Try refreshing the link or replacing the video
error.hostHint: If the source blocks embedded playback, choose another video or a direct link.
error.viewerHint: The host can refresh the link or replace the video for the room.

embedBlocked.label: Embed blocked
embedBlocked.description: The platform did not provide an embedded player or blocked playback inside TeleRave.
embedBlocked.recovery: Best path: open it on the platform or replace the video with a link that allows embedding.

extractionFailed.label: Extraction failed
extractionFailed.description: The proxy or extractor could not get a playable stream. Common causes: age, region, privacy, or an expired link.
extractionFailed.recovery: Best path: refresh the link; if that fails, replace the video or use a direct stream.

directSource.label: Stream cannot play
directSource.description: The direct link, HLS/DASH stream, or proxy response is unavailable to the browser player.
directSource.recovery: Best path: refresh the link or paste another URL with a supported format.

network.label: Network error
network.description: The player did not receive a response from the source or the connection dropped while loading.
network.recovery: Best path: refresh the link and check whether the source opens in a separate tab.

unknown.label: Cause unknown
unknown.description: TeleRave did not receive enough detail from the source to classify the problem.
unknown.recovery: Best path: refresh the link, open it on the platform, or replace the video.

quality.label: Video quality
quality.unavailable: Quality control is not available for this platform

queue.emptyHint: Add a video for sequential playback
queue.urlInputPlaceholder: Paste a video link (YouTube, Twitch, VK, Rutube...)

search.tryDifferentSearch: Try a different query or paste a link directly

embed.notSupportedDesc: {{platform}} cannot be played via embedded player

hls.notSupported: HLS is not supported in this browser
